title: Twisted holographic superconductors in external magnetic field
summary: Among the various applications of the AdS/CFT correspondence in condensed matter physics, the realization of the phase transition between the normal and superconducting phases in holographic quantum field theory is of particular importance. Following seminal papers on holographic superconductors that introduced the basic framework, one major line of development has focused on capturing the Meissner effect with all relevant parameters, which requires the inclusion of an external magnetic field.
